verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a file-conversion product, so the axis applies. However, Convertio states that all conversions take place in its cloud and that no software needs to be installed. Its CLI and PHP wrappers are clients for the hosted API, which requires an API key. They are not a conversion engine you run on your own infrastructure, so there is no evidence of a self-hosted library, container, or server.
